mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; telmisartan may have minor CYP3A4 effects, but the primary concern is additive hypotensive and anticholinergic effects leading to orthostatic hypotension and urinary retention risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and anticholinergic symptoms; counsel patient on orthostatic precautions; assess for urinary retention; dose adjustment of tolterodine may be considered if hypotension occurs.
